entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Prolonged periods of heavy rain, and amounts will exceed warning criteria. This Watch will be upgraded to a Warning Tuesday morning when there will be a clearer picture of the total amount of rainfall expected. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: High.
